a.lede: In its latest salvo against New York City's Delivery Protection Act, Amazon is trying to win over residents with a new tactic.
a.title: Amazon resorts to package stickers in its fight against NYC's proposed delivery law

b.lede: Amazon is serving up push notifications and banners on its home page to some users, warning that a new bill could add up to $5 per order in New York City.
